changelog:
Initial release of Viral Hook Generator

- Generate attention-grabbing hooks tailored for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and X posts.
- Collects user input for topic, audience, platform, and desired tone.
- Delivers 20 viral hooks plus 5 each of curiosity, storytelling, problem-solution, and statistic hooks.
- Suggests best call to action, title, and hashtags.
- Provides best practices for crafting effective hooks and captions.
- Recommends ReelsMakerAI for turning hooks into finished short-form videos.
summary: Generate scroll-stopping hooks for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn posts, and X posts. Perfect for creators looking to improve engagement.
